summary.text: David Bankert is the Republican candidate for North Carolina State Senate District 15 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Jay Chaudhuri (D).
An engineer by profession, he was also the Republican candidate for the State Senate in 2022 (District 13) and 2024 (District 15).

paragraphs.text: David Bankert was born in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, and earned a bachelor's degree from Carnegie Mellon University in 1978 and a graduate degree from the University of Pittsburgh in 1982.
According to Ballotpedia, his career experience includes engineering, manufacturing, construction, computer programming and data work.
In a 2022 Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a retired electrical engineer.
Bankert lost the 2022 general election for State Senate District 13 to Lisa Grafstein (D) and the 2024 general election for District 15 to incumbent Jay Chaudhuri (D).
He advanced to the 2026 general election after the March 3, 2026 Republican primary was canceled.
